name: Starlink Group 15-22
slot_a_text: SpaceX's 104th launch of the year, 723rd all time. 55th from SLC-4E this year, 4 days after the last one. The 204th orbital launch attempt worldwide this year. Falcon 9 is on a 329 flight success streak.
slot_b_text: SpaceX's Falcon 9 uses grid fins cast from a single piece of titanium so strong they are rarely replaced.
description: A batch of 27 satellites for the Starlink mega-constellation - SpaceX's project for space-based Internet communication system.
